expeditions.title: Meadow Walk
expeditions.description: A short stroll through the Stellar Meadow with your Skrumpey. Nothing dangerous, just good company.

steps.narrative: The Stellar Meadow is in full bloom. Your Skrumpey tugs your sleeve and points down two trails.
The trail loops back and the sun is warm. Your companion is humming.

choices.label: Sit and share the snack you brought.
Head home — there's still time for chores.
